purpose: Define how complete source-registry statuses map to runtime activity without losing authority restrictions.

current-institutional-with-stale-technic.restriction: May support compatible institutional detail but must not govern a technical-scope rule or select a technical-standard edition.

current-with-superseded-provisions.restriction: Promotion to the runtime subset requires an explicit source override after the still-operative provision is identified and overridden provisions are excluded.

ibge-tabular-1993.reason: Runtime status narrows the current registry entry to the delegated tabular-presentation scope.
